author: Mak, Julian

steps.title: Edit NEMO GEOMETRIC code
steps.instruction: Edit in newest version, 15 Oct 2023: ( important ) there is a bug NEMO GEOMETRIC code (advection of parameterised eddy energy; see ldfeke.F90), fixed in the present version processed data for UNAGI using GEOMETRIC updated FLAT_UNAGI data not updated, as the presence of advection seems to make very little difference in the sample calculations (likely because that model is uniform in the zonal direction, unlike in UNAGI where a ridge is present) ver. 2 contains a streamlined version of the data; see ver. 1 for samples of other data not included in the article itself (e.g. FLAT_UNAGI) ================= Data for "Energetic scale-awareness in an eddy energy constrained mesoscale eddy parameterization". Contains NEMO modification files for "splitting" procedure algorithm input and config files for the idealised configuration ("UNAGI" and "FLAT_UNAGI") sample data to reproduce plots in the paper some supplementary data from "UNAGI" and "FLAT_UNAGI" Files collected in different zip files to avoid the need to download the whole pack in one go (e.g. if only the "splitting" algorithm source files are desired). See readme for data/folder structure.
